snippet.title: Address The Mess - Official Announcement Trailer [Cozy Tidy-up Narrative Game]
snippet.description:
Address The Mess is a single-player narrative sim. Clean up the scattered post, use magic, solve puzzles, find props and assemble furniture. Unlock & use magic spells and be unstoppable, or relax and enjoy the narrative sim at your own pace, with a spirit doggo, cat and your friendly mail pigeon.
-- 
Story: 
You have been left in charge of your grandpa's cozy post office for a day.  It turns out to be a day full of chaos, magic and mystery. Your goal is to keep it as clean as you found it whilst uncovering narrative stories.

-- 
Play the demo & Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5357350/Address_The_Mess/

Follow us on Instagram: 
https://www.instagram.com/huebook.games/
